import polars as pl

# Create a sample DataFrame
df_original = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "salary": [50000.0, 60000.0, 70000.0]
})

# Serialize to Parquet bytes (entirely in memory)
parquet_bytes = df_original.write_parquet()

# Deserialize back to DataFrame from bytes
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(parquet_bytes)

# Verify round trip
assert df_original.equals(df_restored)
print("Round trip successful!")
print(df_restored)
